}}'''Lemore Genhal''' is a young noblewoman from [[Tanchico]] who was made ''[[damane]]'' by the [[Seanchan]].

== History and abilities ==
Lemore was nineteen years old when she was captured.

== Activities ==
Lemore manifested the [[spark]] just few days before the Seanchan arrive in Tanchico. Found while trying to escape, she was captured, made immediately ''damane'' and renamed '''Larie'''.

She is later captured by [[Rand al'Thor]]'s forces on the Seanchan campaign for [[Illian]]. She is sent to [[Elayne Trakand]] in [[Caemlyn]]. The [[Kin]], Elayne, and [[Nynaeve]] look after her in the hope she will reclaim her freedom again. She does make a decent recovery, but would have been paralyzed if faced by a ''sul'dam'' who wanted to collar her. She knows she should hate the Seanchan and is puzzled that she does not.
